justifications.fit: the split follows the section-8 contract: every moved statement is carried byte-identical into exactly one module, patches are repointed to the module whose code now reads them, and the server re-exports the moved names so the import surface is unchanged.

justifications.reuse: the token estimate is taken from reckon.crew.routing._tokens_for_bytes rather than a second copy of the ratio, the move is checked by the shared scripts/check_pure_move.py, and no moved code is re-derived.
